evidence: Titanium tetrachloride (TiCl 4) and ammonia (NH 3) were used as precursors. Trimethylaluminum ((CH3)3Al, TMA) was used as a reducing agent between TiCl 4and NH3 pulses. TiCl 4 pulse length was 400 ms and purge time 7 s. TMA pulse length was 200 ms and purge time 2 s. NH3 pulse time was 300 ms and purge time 7 s.
